newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Adsteam confirms NatCon sale.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Adsteam confirms NatCon sale.

text.p: The Adelaide Steamship Co Ltd said on Tuesday it had sold 30.748 million shares in industrial products firm National Consolidated Ltd at 90 cents each.
Adsteam said the 15.3 percent stake was placed on-market by BT Securities and McIntosh Corporate.
Adsteam affiliate Tooth and To Ltd said in a separate statement that it had sold 6.467 million National Consolidated shares, or 3.22 percent, on-market at the same price and through the same brokers.
National Consolidated has 200.78 million shares on issue. Its shares closed 10 cents lower on Tuesday at 99 cents.
The Melbourne-based company is more than 40 percent owned by Malaysia Mining Corp Bhd.
Adsteam said it would have total gross proceeds of A$32.1 million from Tuesday's share sale while Tooth said its gross proceeds were A$6.8 million. Both were in excess of book value.
The Adsteam group, which remains under the control of its bank creditors after billions of dollars of debt soured in the early 1990's, did not say what it would do with the funds.
